EventText: Thank the stars you made it.
The empire caught us by suprise. We barely got out alive. This is it. We're all that's left of the fleet.
Our ship is badly damaged, and some our systems our down, but we must get back and running and get to the [color=yellow]beacon[/color] at the end of this sector before the empire hunt us down.
Our long range sensors detect that your ship, along with several ships with imperial markings, recently jumped to the sector.
We don't have much to offer you, but we can refuel you. Better than it falling into the hands of the empire if we fall
